about_h2: About AB Towing & Transport of NC, LLC
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers powersports and small equipment, winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport. We work out of Princeton and the towns around it.
area_h2: We work in and around Princeton
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Powersports and small equipment
services.body: Golf carts and yard machines are winched up and strapped down the same way a car is, so they arrive the way they left.
services.evidence: Two company trucks, a pickup and a flatbed, parked side by side

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.evidence: Classic project car recovery loaded onto the flatbed from a wooded storage yard

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.evidence: Rollback tow truck backed up for a residential vehicle pickup, house and trees behind it

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.evidence: Orange storage building secured and hauled on a flatbed at night with hazard lights on

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.
services.evidence: Orange storage building secured and hauled on a flatbed at night with hazard lights on

reviews.author: Michael Hernandez
reviews.text: Very professional! They were called yesterday and were here to pick up the car first thing in the morning. I did not have to do anything but hand the keys over! Will definitely use them again if needed!

reviews.author: Darlene Earl
reviews.text: I got in an accident, my car was towed to their facility. When we went to get my belongings multiple items were missing. (Not stored in a place where they just fell out) I hope someone there is enjoying the stuff that they stole from me.

reviews.author: Audrey lewis
reviews.text: Stranded from home by 2 hours and from our destination by 2 hours, these guys were the best. After insurance was not helpful, these guys saved the day and took 4 of us to the car dealership to get our car fixed. Wonderful place to use.

reviews.author: Anna Parker
reviews.text: I had an accident back in February of this year and they were at the scene in less than 5 minutes. I had some insurance trouble so my car was at their place for quite some time and they would always keep me in the loop of things. They are open 24 hours so I could call them anytime and they are SUPER flexible - especially when I lived about 45 minutes from Princeton I had to go back and forth a few times to get stuff out of my totaled car. I have kept their card just in case for future needs and would go to them first! They're great.

reviews.author: Paul Heflebower
reviews.text: Lost my power steering on 95 and had to pull over in Kinley, NC at the travel plaza. Saw a tow truck in the parking lot and called the number. Glen and Luke came out and said they could help me at their shop the next morning. They had me in the shop at 8 and out by 10. Back on my way to Daytona. These guys are the best! Honest, hard working, very fair price and just good people. This father and son team are the best! I HIGHLY recommend them for any service or towing.

reviews.author: Bennet Pike
reviews.text: Highly recommended!! Jason and his son, Brody, went above and beyond to recover my truck. It was not an easy recovery but Jason did not leave us hanging and went out of his way to help. I can not recommend AB towing more highly. Jason is a great guy!!

reviews.author: Tasha Olkowski
reviews.text: My family and 2 small dogs were traveling back to Florida from a week vacation when we were in an accident on I95 south. Took a while for highway patrol to arrive but once the the truck was called, Mark showed up super fast. You can imagine being stuck in another state with a small child and 2 small dogs, all of us feeling helpless and lost and upset about how to get home. Mark was amazing! He kept us calm, gave us a ton of information, and even knew a nice pet friendly hotel to take us to for the rest of the day until the rental car opened the next day. He was a true God send to us and we can't thank him enough!

reviews.author: Bryan Hamilton
reviews.text: My wife broke down near Princeton, NC on her way to Durham for the weekend. A local deputy got her in touch with AB towing and she had a wonderful experience with Luke and Glenn and AB Towing in a bad circumstance. After some analysis of the car, and some initial work, it seemed to be catastrophic failure requiring extensive warrantee-related work at the dealership. They provided good advice and were available to tow her to the dealer. It is nice to have reputable service centers and reliable towing companies to help in times of crisis! AB towing is such a place! Thank-You

reviews.author: Jenn Kirby
reviews.text: My truck broke down and Glenn came out within 15 minutes of calling. He was professional, personable and very funny while talking with my young daughter and I. I highly recommend using AB towing if you ever have the unfortunate need of a tow truck. Thank you again Glenn.

reviews.author: Jamie Kirkman
reviews.text: Called on a Sunday afternoon to haul a 1 ton van from Princeton to Vanceboro. Very courteous, friendly guys. Showed up quick and got my vehicle home at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Stuart Smith
reviews.text: Fast and reliable service. Went above and beyond having to cut my rusted spare tire hardware off my boat trailer in order to change tire. Outstanding service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Michael Zahra
reviews.text: i broke down while on a road trip for work called and luke answered and was more thank happy to assist me right away! great company i definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Molly Embler
reviews.text: My daughter locked her keys in her car with it running and her dog in the car. Arrived quickly and so nice. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Boysie Ragoonanan
reviews.text: Answered on my 1st call. Very professional , came when they said they would an very reasonable price. Highly Recommended

reviews.author: Eddie Beal
reviews.text: Guy charged me $100 to toe 2 miles down the road. And said it was a discount because I lived on the same town as him. What a joke and a scam

reviews.author: Robert Phillips
reviews.text: I would recommend this place to everyone very friendly and nice people a father and son business. They took very good care of my family
